title: Felix and the Vector
author: Jonah Voss
blurb: Bram Montrose, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
